methodology.context_policy: Physical/opponent context and FEP belief frozen at observed start; only predicted action state changes. No future logged states are inputs.
methodology.selection: validation only: highest near-change accuracy under no-change-path false-alarm limit; default .10; fallback lowest false-alarm rate
methodology.excluded: gaps and paths containing forced/terminal/unknown classes
methodology.caveat: Existing test informed the original plan. No new-session validation or counterfactual HP/game-state accuracy is claimed.
methodology.fep_features: three causally filtered start beliefs appended
methodology.timing: warm per-start single-row calls; excludes loading and initial feature/FEP extraction; includes beam maintenance for rollout timing
